subject: Approval: Press & Social Asset Use in Exchange for One-time Q3 Discount
messages:
From: Caroline Wu <caroline@atlas-analytics.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.example
Cc: procurement@atlas-analytics.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: permission to reference Redwood + ask about Q3 commercial concession

Hi Aisha,

Quick one — Atlas is planning a short customer highlight ahead of our Q3 product launch and we'd love to feature Redwood as a named partner (quote + logo on our press page and social posts). We can offer a short joint announcement and a 2-post social plan (Twitter/X + LinkedIn) if Redwood is open to it.

Separately, procurement asked whether you can provide a one-time credit for our Q3 invoice — our CFO is pushing for a concession tied to the visibility (we're looking at a one-time 20% credit). Before I put legal on the press copy, can you confirm whether Redwood would consider exchanging marketing permission for a commercial concession? If so, what terms do you need (logo usage window, exclusivity, testimonial rights)?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

— Caroline
VP Marketing, Atlas Analytics
Attachments: Atlas_Procurement_Form.pdf
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.example
To: Caroline Wu <caroline@atlas-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example, neha_kapoor@redwood.example
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: permission to reference Redwood + ask about Q3 commercial concession

Caroline —

Really appreciate the outreach and congrats on the launch. Short answer: we can probably do a one-time commercial concession tied to a co-marketing commitment, but we need internal approvals on both the dollar impact and the publicity terms.

High level proposed trade:
- One-time 20% credit on Q3 invoice (applied as a bill credit)
- In exchange: 12-month logo and quote usage across Atlas public-facing channels, one joint press release, and permission for Redwood to republish the quote on our marketing site and socials.

What we need from you to move fast: the finalized press language (we can review edits), confirmation you can sign the procurement form, and confirmation there is no exclusivity in the ask. I've attached a draft press release (Draft_Press_Release_v1.docx) so legal can see proposed wording.

I'll escalate internally for approvals — looping in Marissa and Vivek for deal desk signoff. If approvals are quick we can get DocuSign and the credit applied before your Q3 billing date.

— Aisha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

On attachments: Draft_Press_Release_v1.docx
From: marissa_cole@redwood.example
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.example, neha_kapoor@redwood.example
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example
Date: Sun, 13 Jul 2025 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: permission to reference Redwood + ask about Q3 commercial concession

Aisha / Neha —

This is straightforward but needs a quick deal-desk ok. Financial impact: a one-time 20% credit on a Q3 invoice for a mid-market account is material to our acquisition economics. My initial position: approve up to 15% as an AE-level concession; anything 16–25% requires exec signoff.

Marketing ask looks reasonable but we need guardrails stated explicitly: no exclusive endorsement, usage limited to web/social/press for 12 months, Redwood reserves the right to review the final press language and request small edits. Also confirm Atlas will provide a quote attribution with the name and title.

I'll +1 the idea conditionally if Vivek signs off on the 20% and legal confirms the press copy edits are acceptable. Vivek — can you approve the higher concession if marketing terms are limited to what I outlined?

HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/deal/DL-2025-319 — ACV: $180k (year 1), one-time Q3 invoice estimate: $15k

— Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example
To: marissa_cole@redwood.example, aisha_rahman@redwood.example
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 10:51:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: permission to reference Redwood + ask about Q3 commercial concession

Marissa / team —

Thanks for the clear summary. I approve a one-time 20% credit on the Q3 invoice on these conditions:
- Marketing rights are non-exclusive; rights limited to 12 months (web, press release, and social). No rights for paid advertising or inclusion in third-party partner collateral without separate approval.
- Redwood must review and sign off on final press language prior to publication; minor edits permitted.
- Procurement form needs to include an explicit line item for the credit and sign-off by both parties.
- Discount will be processed as a bill credit (one-time) and will not change core contract pricing or renewal terms.

Neha — please confirm finance side can process a 20% one-time credit for the estimated invoice amount and confirm the operational steps (credit note, billing code). Legal to redline press copy; Aisha, please coordinate a short turnaround with Atlas (48 hours).

— Vivek
COO, Redwood Inference
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.example
To: Caroline Wu <caroline@atlas-analytics.com>, Atlas Analytics Procurement <procurement@atlas-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example, neha_kapoor@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: permission to reference Redwood + ask about Q3 commercial concession

Caroline — great news, thanks for the draft. Vivek has approved the one-time 20% Q3 credit conditional on the limited marketing terms below. To recap the final commitments from Redwood:

- One-time 20% credit applied to Q3 invoice (will be processed as a bill credit).
- Atlas may use Redwood's logo and a short quote (provided by Redwood) across Atlas website, press release, and social channels for 12 months starting at publication.
- No exclusivity; no paid ads or third-party partner placements without additional signoff.
- Redwood to review and sign the final press language prior to publication; we will provide minor edits if needed.

Next steps for Atlas:
1) Please sign the attached procurement form and upload to the DocuSign link: https://docusign.example/atlas-redwood-q3-319
2) Share the final press release text in the Drive link so legal can review (https://drive.example.com/press-draft). We need the final language within 48 hours to meet billing timings.

If you confirm those two items we will have finance issue the credit within the billing cycle. Thanks — happy to jump on a call if that helps speed things up.

— Aisha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Draft_Press_Release_v1.docx, Atlas_Procurement_Form.pdf
